paragraphs: Yosi ben Yoezer of Tzeredah; Avot, chapter 1, mishnah 4.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source has יעזר/ויעזר, Yaezer/and-Yaezer. Named Miqra according to the Masorah at I Chronicles 12:7 reads ויועזר, Yoezer. Supplied forms remain unchanged; earlier audit יועזר and provisional arbitrary-region status do not settle the heading or extent.

פ״יב־ז gives 12:7. אבות פ״א מ״ד explicitly gives Avot chapter 1 mishnah 4, without independent checking of that second locus. The biblical example and Yosi ben Yoezer attestation remain separate, with no title added or identity merged.
